admission.justification: A parked master needs to retain a writable history across validation failures and preserve confirmations written after an interrupted close.

applicability: Managed structural memory merges for a master that stop on content conflicts before committing.
conditions: The open history belongs to the active merge parent pair.
Recovery restores closure state only when current disk and stage zero both remain operation-owned.
exclusions: Plain merges, clean merges without a park, and restoration of parked authoring after commit.
statement: A master's structural merge opens crossing history when it parks before commit, restores only checkpoint-owned closing state if continuation refuses, preserves later crossing rows, and retires close checkpoints after verified commit or rollback.
